archetypes.name: dyn-routing-pins
archetypes.rationale: Changed dense /implement routing prose with many pinned contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed /implement SKILL.md routing prose for semantic drift around rebase checkpoints, bootstrap routing, and Step 8+ ship-driver continuations. Verify mandatory-read timing, route predicates, and handoff recovery instructions still match the tested contracts. Pay special attention to wording that could alter operator behavior despite passing literal pins. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
